parameters.name: DefenceMode
parameters.description:
The prevention mode. Valid values:

*   **block**: Interception Mode
*   **audit**: Alert Mode

parameters.name: Dir
parameters.description: The directory for which you want to enable web tamper proofing.

parameters.name: ExclusiveDir
parameters.description:
The directory for which you want to disable web tamper proofing.

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ExclusiveFile
parameters.description:
The file for which you want to disable web tamper proofing.

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: ExclusiveFileType
parameters.description:
The type of the file for which you want to disable web tamper proofing. Separate multiple types with semicolons (;). Valid values:

*   php
*   jsp
*   asp
*   aspx
*   js
*   cgi
*   html
*   htm
*   xml
*   shtml
*   shtm
*   jpg
*   gif
*   png

> If you set **Mode** to **blacklist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The ID of the protected directory for which you want to change the status of web tamper proofing.

> You can call the [DescribeWebLockConfigList](~~DescribeWebLockConfigList~~) operation to query the IDs of protected directories.

parameters.name: InclusiveFile
parameters.description:
The file for which you want to enable web tamper proofing.

> If you set **Mode** to **whitelist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: InclusiveFileType
parameters.description:
The type of the file for which you want to enable web tamper proofing. Separate multiple types with semicolons (;). Valid values:

*   php
*   jsp
*   asp
*   aspx
*   js
*   cgi
*   html
*   htm
*   xml
*   shtml
*   shtm
*   jpg
*   gif
*   png

> If you set **Mode** to **whitelist**, you must specify this parameter.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: LocalBackupDir
parameters.description:
The local path to the backup files of the protected directory.\
The directory format of a Linux server is different from that of a Windows server. You must enter the directory in the required format based on your operating system. Examples:

*   Linux server: /usr/local/aegis/bak
*   Windows server: C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The protection mode of web tamper proofing. Valid values:

*   **whitelist**: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the specified directories and file types.
*   **blacklist**: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the unspecified subdirectories, file types, and files in the protected directory.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server on which the protected directory is located.

> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-update-config --source-ip 36.112.XX.XX --lang zh --id 312077 --uuid 4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000 --dir /home/admin/tomcat --exclusive-dir /home/admin/test --exclusive-file-type jpg --local-backup-dir /usr/local/backup --biz-mode blacklist --inclusive-file-type jpg --exclusive-file /home/admin/apache.log --inclusive-file /home/admin/test.log --defence-mode block --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockUpdateConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InclusiveFileType jpg --ExclusiveDir '/home/admin/test' --Mode blacklist --Lang zh --Dir '/home/admin/tomcat' --InclusiveFile '/home/admin/test.log' --ExclusiveFile '/home/admin/apache.log' --SourceIp '36.112.XX.XX' --Uuid '4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000' --DefenceMode block --LocalBackupDir '/usr/local/backup' --ExclusiveFileType jpg --Id 312077
